name: harness-start
description: Harness Start plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: file-line-budget-guard
plugins.description: Ratchet-enforced file line budget guard: prevents source files from exceeding per-language line limits.

plugins.name: command-safety-guards
plugins.description: Command safety guards: deny broad recursive deletion, unbacked sed in-place edits, and cat heredoc writes outside temporary directories.

plugins.name: process-confidence
plugins.description: Observable delivery process: validated session begin, hook receipts, auto complete, Stop gate (hooks never auto-begin).

plugins.name: in-chinese
plugins.description: Keeps agent prose in Simplified Chinese and blocks long Korean, Japanese, or Thai language drift at response boundaries.
